Hi Mark - thanks for the note and for escalating this. Short answer: yes, we can accept an ST-3 (resale/exemption) for Minnesota to remove sales tax on qualifying invoices.

What we need from you to validate and reprocess the invoice:
- A signed Minnesota ST-3 (or equivalent state resale certificate) that lists NorthShore Retail, Inc. as the purchaser.
- NorthShore legal name and Minnesota tax ID (if applicable) or Federal EIN.
- The certificate must be effective on the invoice date (05/31/2027).

Preferred delivery options: secure upload portal (recommended): https://drive.redwood.com/s/secure-upload/NS_INV009827 OR send to billing@redwood.com with subject line INV-009827 ST-3.

I attached a short checklist and our preferred ST-3 template for reference (MN-ST3-instructions.pdf). Once we receive the signed PDF we will validate it with Finance and reissue the invoice without sales tax if it meets the acceptance criteria.

Cc'ing Monica from Finance to lock this down.
